notes:
Package for gh.facebookresearch/house3d (House3D RoomNavTask) served on the fake backend only. The upstream environment was not run: House3D.roomnav imports the compiled objrender pybind extension (House3D/roomnav.py:18) and needs SUNCG house data, config.json and OpenCV (INSTRUCTION.md:59-63). The fake is a pure Python kinematic 5x5 grid stand-in for RoomNavTask with discrete_action=True and Discrete(13), not the renderer; it was never compared with the upstream environment. Not covered and disclosed in the fidelity gaps: the real observation is (120, 90, 4) at the default resolution named in House3D/roomnav.py:58, while the fake returns a reduced 4x4x4 array; the delta/linear/indicator/speed reward shaping of roomnav.py:324-345 is not modelled; success is a distance proxy for the semantic-pixel 'see' criterion (roomnav.py:57-60); the continuous Tuple action space (roomnav.py:135) is not modelled because the package serves the discrete-action configuration; reset seed/options are the gymnasium bridge's convention (upstream reset takes only target and seeds in the constructor); there is no snapshot/restore because RoomNavTask has set_state but no get_state. The device is simulated R0 with no hardware backend and no native stop; the e-stop is the runtime's software latch. The gate reports the expected family-bridge warnings G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only affects the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the derived integer inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.index); there are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. The upstream clone was left unmodified, and this model-authored package was not reviewed by a human and has no hardware run.
